targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Scored company targets exported from Void Radar.

default.target_roles: CTO; Founder; Head of Talent; VP Engineering
default.reason_to_write: Generic job board detected for braincorp.com.

apiKeyEnv.title: Apollo API key env var
apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing the Apollo API key.

apolloApiKey.title: Apollo API key
apolloApiKey.description: Optional encrypted Apollo API key input. Use this if you cannot find actor environment variables in Apify Console.

maxItems.title: Maximum companies
maxItems.description: Maximum number of company targets to process from the input.

perCompanySearchLimit.title: Search results per company
perCompanySearchLimit.description: Maximum Apollo People Search results to inspect for each company.

maxContactsPerCompany.title: Maximum verified contacts per company
maxContactsPerCompany.description: Maximum verified provider contacts to emit for each company.

maxEnrichmentsPerRun.title: Maximum paid enrichments per run
maxEnrichmentsPerRun.description: Hard cap on Apollo enrichment attempts for the whole run.

requestDelayMs.title: Request delay
requestDelayMs.description: Delay between company-level enrichment attempts in milliseconds.

revealPhoneNumber.title: Reveal phone number
revealPhoneNumber.description: Keep false; phone enrichment requires webhook handling.

runWaterfallEmail.title: Run waterfall email
runWaterfallEmail.description: Keep false unless a webhook flow is implemented.

emitMissesToDataset.title: Emit misses to dataset
emitMissesToDataset.description: When true, emit miss records for companies without verified contacts.
